premiumBody: Spotify requires the connected account to have Premium so Bagel can control playback and add song requests to your queue.
welcomeBody: Let your community pick what plays next. I’ll help you connect Spotify, one little step at a time.
appTitle: A little app. A lot of music.
appBody: Your Spotify app is the bridge between Bagel and your music. Create it in the Spotify developer dashboard, then add this redirect URL in its settings.
credentialsBody: Open your app’s settings in Spotify and copy the two keys below. Bagel will keep your secret safely tucked away.
connectBody: Your app is ready. Now connect the Spotify account you play music from, and we’ll bring you back here to set up song requests.
readyBody: Spotify is connected. Next, choose how your viewers request songs: a chat command, channel points, or both.
saved: Your app is saved and ready.
previewHint: Try the flow without connecting an account.
redirectMissing: The callback URL is not available yet. You can continue once song requests are configured.
